The '''''Leviathan''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury spaceliner]] in service sometime before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. It had a game room, lounges, seating areas, an interactive [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] suite, and eating areas. It was often filled with passengers from many different worlds, who often talked, ate, and played games of chance to pass the time, filling the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with noise. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used this spaceliner to get to [[Telos system/Legends|Telos]] in an unofficial mission to capture [[Xanatos]].
